_about: K-1219 (ADR-091 Ek 6): how a move's nine drawn frames become its loop clip (tools/media_loop.py). Picked on the squat pilot of 25 Nov 2026: at these numbers most moments show one crisp frame and the steps still read as one movement; longer crossfades stack two poses into a ghost. A look, not a measurement. max_bytes: the most one clip may weigh, so forty of them add a few MB to the app, not tens. floor_*: the floor line of each frame (the longest dark row in the lower half of a cell, darker than floor_dark_level on at least floor_min_fraction of the width) is lined up with the first frame's, so a grid drawn with rows a few pixels apart plays without a jump; max_shift_px bounds the move and pads the grid.
